zh-CN.name: 高密度数据看板
zh-CN.description: 面向经常比较和定位细节的专业用户，在可读的基础上集中呈现较多指标、表格和筛选。高密度来自有效组织，不等于缩小所有字号或去掉间距。
use_when: 专业用户需要同时比较多项数据。
具有稳定的表格结构和明确筛选维度。
avoid_when: 新用户缺少指标解释时会难以理解。
不要牺牲文字可读性与可点击区域。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 用稳定网格、紧凑但清楚的表格和分组标签增加有效密度；筛选条件保持可见，数字列对齐并标出单位；按任务提供详情展开或聚焦视图，不以小字号代替信息组织。

en.name: Data-Dense Dashboard
en.description: A dashboard approach for expert users who compare and locate detailed information frequently. Density comes from effective organization of metrics, tables and filters, not from shrinking every label or eliminating spacing.
use_when: Expert users need to compare multiple data points simultaneously.
Stable tables and clear filtering dimensions support the task.
avoid_when: Unexplained metrics make the page difficult for new users.
Do not trade away legibility or usable interaction targets.
en.prompt_template: Increase useful density with a stable grid, compact readable tables and grouped labels. Keep filters visible, align numeric columns and show units. Provide task-based detail or focus views instead of substituting tiny text for organization.
